description: Send a one-time verification code (OTP) by SMS for login, registration or payment confirmation. TopSMS generates and stores the code; returns a verification id. Limits: 5 codes per number per hour, 30 s between codes.

brand.description: Your app or company name shown in the SMS ("MyShop: your verification code is ...").

from.description: Approved Sender ID (max 11 chars). Omit to use the default sender "TopSMS".

to.description: Phone number in international format, e.g. +420601234567 (Czech numbers without prefix are accepted).

name: verify_send
